_comment: PLATFORMS — the accounts a service is actually run on.
WHY THIS IS A FILE AND NOT A NUMBER. Both platform-management features are
priced per platform, and until now the only record of WHICH platforms was
a display string on a package row: "Meta Ads management", "Facebook +
Instagram", "Meta + Google Ads". A quantity you can count and a scope you
cannot read are not the same thing — an automation, a quotation or an agent
needs to know Google Ads, not "two".
EXTENSIBLE BY DESIGN. Adding a platform is one entry here. Nothing in the
builder, the styles or the scripts names a platform, so a new one appears
in the chooser, in both languages, with no code change.
`executionSteps` IS THE HOOK FOR LATER. The workflow of running a campaign
does not change because the platform changed — the objective, the stages
and the approval points are the same — so today every entry leaves it
empty rather than inventing a difference. Where a genuine platform-specific
step exists (a verification a platform demands, a format only it accepts),
it goes here and build-catalogue.js appends it to the materialised workflow
of every feature scoped to that platform. The schema is ready; the content
is honest about not existing yet.
Ids are permanent and language-neutral, like every other id in this
catalogue.
